import json, os, pathlib, sys
here = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[0]).resolve().parent
base = here.parent
with open(base / "npm-calls", "a") as out:
    out.write(json.dumps(dict(argv=sys.argv, path=os.environ.get("PATH"))) + "\n")
mode = json.loads((base / "npm-mode.json").read_text())

    package = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[3]) / "node_modules" / sys.argv[8].rsplit("@", 1)[0]

    if mode.get("bin", True):

        (package / "dist/index.js").write_text("// fixture adapter\n")
sys.exit(mode.get("exit", 0))
